# GOT symbol identity debt -- GENERATED by `make got-debt`
#   (python3 tools/gotident.py --write-debt, after a full `make check`).
# One row = one green copy (SYMBOL@UNIT) with identical instructions that references
# through the GOT at least one global symbol different from the original, with the
# distance and fingerprint of the two sequences. The gate fails for a dirty green copy
# not listed here, or for a row whose distance grows / whose fingerprint changes.
# By default `make got-debt` only removes rows; adding rows needs --add.
# `[TU]` = TU boundary: move the body, do not rename. See tools/gotident.py.
